service.description: The contract of an owner's audit source (a projection's sourceService): the audit rows of the given registered projections that are within the caller's own scope, newest first. projectionList is the registered projections of this source the caller may read (auditProjectionId, changedEntityName, changedFieldName); the owner reads only the entities it knows and checks ADMIN_AUDIT_VIEW itself. The filters are the caller's (changedByUserId, recordKey matched to either key value, visitId, fromDate and thruDate in milliseconds, actorOnly for the rows a signed-in user made), limit the rows to answer. It answers ids only (auditIdList, of EntityAuditLog.auditHistorySeqId) and changeCount, how many match in the caller's scope: never a value.

Changes the audit log recorded, newest first, of the registered projections the caller may read (changeList, a page at a time): when (changedDate in milliseconds and changedDateText in the user's zone), who (changedByUserId, actorName), what (the projection's category and description, the entity and field it is of, the record by its key values with their names), the values before and after where the registration shows them (else masked true with marker: set, changed, cleared or recorded), the reason given, the session it was made in (correlation) and the owner's place for the record (linkKey, linkId). Narrowed by category, auditProjectionId (a registered one, never an entity or a field), changedByUserId, recordKey (a key value of the record, whole), correlation, fromDate and thruDate, and with actorOnly to the changes a signed-in user made (a data load's own rows, which name no user, left out). A record that belongs to an organization is found by its owner within the caller's scope. Reads at most maxDepth rows from the newest: deeper is refused with notice (narrow the dates). forExport answers one page of exportRows rows, truncated true when more match. A source that cannot be read is named in sourceProblems and the others are answered. projectionList and categoryList are the options of a find. Needs ADMIN_AUDIT_VIEW.

The owner's audit source a registration names, for find#Changes: sourceService must be the sourceService of a registered projection and carry the find#OwnedChanges contract; the projections given to it are read from the registry here (those of the source the caller may read, narrowed to auditProjectionIdList), never from the request. It is called under the caller's own authorization: this service's ALL_USERS ALLOW (AdminAuditSource) is not inheritable, so the owner's service is authorized as a direct call is and finds within the caller's scope. result is the owner's answer. Needs ADMIN_AUDIT_VIEW.
